senses.gloss: (Saf. of לעם; cmp. לעט, לעס) to swallow; to ruin (corresp. to h. בלע).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 10:8">Targ. Job X, 8</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְסַלְעַם</he>; f. <he>מְסַלְעֲמָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Nahum 3:11">Targ. Nah. III, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 9:15">Targ. Is. IX, 15</cite> <he>מְסִלְעֲמִין</he> (Hebraism).

senses.gloss: to be swallowed up, ruined. Ib. XXVIII, 7; a. fr.
